meta.title: Dalilin Pain001: Hujjar Kasuwanci cikin Tambayoyi Biyar
meta.description: Abin da fayil ɗin biyan kuɗi da aka ƙi ke kashewa, dalilin da ya sa bayanan biyan kuɗi masu tsari ke da muhimmanci har yanzu bayan Swift ta ɗage wa'adinta, abin da Pain001 ke yi, kuɗinsa (babu), da ko yana da aminci. Kowace amsa na da hujjarta.
meta.deck: Tambayoyi biyar da CFO ke yi na gaske, an amsa su cikin sauƙaƙƙen harshe, kuma kowace magana na da hanyar haɗi zuwa shaidarta.

text.What does a rejected payment file cost?<: Menene fayil ɗin biyan kuɗi da aka ƙi ke kashewa?#
text.A file the bank bounces does not fail qu: Fayil da banki ya ƙi ba ya gaza cikin shiru. Dole ne wani ya gano lambar dalilin ƙin, ya gyara bayanan asali, ya sake samarwa, ya sake mikawa. Kuma idan gyaran ya rasa lokacin rufewa na ranar, sasantawa za ta jinkirta. Ga jerin albashi ko na masu samar da kaya, jinkirin rana guda kiran waya ne da ba kwa son yi. Jagorar lambobin dalili tana lissafa abin da bankuna ke mayarwa a zahiri; kusan kowace shigarwa ta ajin tsari a cikinta ana iya rigakafinta kafin mikawa.
text.Why act before Swift sets the new date?<: Me ya sa za a ɗauki mataki kafin Swift ta sanya sabuwar rana?#
text.Because the requirement did not change,: Domin buƙatar ba ta canza ba, ranarta kaɗai ce ta canza. A watan Agusta 2026 Swift ta ɗage dokar da ke ƙin adiresoshin gidan waya marasa tsari gaba ɗaya a biyan kuɗi na tsakanin ƙasashe (CBPR+), tare da sauyawa daga MT101 zuwa pain.001 sigar 9 tsakanin bankuna, kuma za ta wallafa sabon lokaci kafin ƙarshen Disamba 2026. Aikin da ke bayan duka biyun yana cikin bayanan asali na abokan cinikinku, kuma yana ɗaukar lokaci fiye da zagayen fitarwa guda. Sauran ranakun suna nan daram: Yuni 2027 don bincike, Nuwamba 2027 don lambobin manufar CHAPS da fitarwa ta gaba ta Fedwire, Nuwamba 2028 don bayanan asusu. An ambaci majiyoyin a cikin taƙaitaccen bayani na 2026, jadawalin kuma yana kan taswirar hanya mai rayuwa.
text.What does Pain001 do about it?<a class=\: Menene Pain001 ke yi game da hakan?#
text.Three things. It turns the data you alre: Abubuwa uku. Yana mai da bayanan da kuke da su tuni (maƙunsar bayanai, fitarwar ERP, tsofaffin fayilolin SWIFT) zuwa fayilolin biyan kuɗi na ISO 20022 da bankuna ke karɓa. Yana tabbatar da tsabtar kowane fayil kafin mikawa: tantancewa bisa ƙa'idar hukuma ta banki (ISO 20022 XSD), lissafin binciken lambar asusu da bankinku ke gudanarwa (ISO 13616 mod-97), da jimillolin sarrafawa da ake sake lissafawa daga bayanan, ba a taɓa amincewa da su kawai ba. Kuma yana yin duk wannan a kan na'urorinku, ba tare da ɗora komai zuwa ko'ina ba.
text.What does it cost?<a class=\"heading-anc: Nawa ne kuɗinsa?#
text.Nothing, at any scale, permanently. The: Babu komai, a kowane girma, har abada. Ainihin fakitin na da lasisi biyu (Apache-2.0 ko MIT); fakitin rakiya suna ƙarƙashin Apache-2.0. Mafi kusancin misalin kasuwanci, wato SDK na fassara na SWIFT, an lissafa shi a fili kan €10,000–30,000 a kowace shekara kafin ƙoƙarin haɗawa. Cikakken hoton, gami da inda dandamalin kasuwanci ke cin nasara da gaske, yana cikin kwatancen.
text.Optional and separate: a supported relea: Na zaɓi kuma dabam: hanyar fitowa mai tallafi, ƙirƙirar bayanan sirri bisa jagorar bankinku, da taimakon haɗawa, ga ƙungiyoyin da ke buƙatar wani ɓangare mai suna da nauyi a kansa. Duba shafin kamfanoni; software ɗin kanta ta kasance kyauta.
text.Is it safe?<a class=\"heading-anchor\" h: Yana da aminci?#
text.Check rather than trust: payment data <a: Bincika maimakon amincewa: bayanan biyan kuɗi ba sa barin na'urorinku, jerin abubuwan dogaro SBOM ne da aka wallafa, lambar tana riƙe da kashi 100% na rufe rassa a matsayin ƙofar CI, kuma gwajin burauza yana gayyatar ƙungiyar tsaronku su ƙaryata da'awoyin tare da buɗe DevTools.
text.What is the next step?<a class=\"heading: Menene mataki na gaba?#
text.Watch it work: the <a href=\"/try/\">60-: Ku ga yadda yake aiki: gwajin daƙiƙa 60 yana tantance rukunin biyan kuɗi kuma yana tabbatar da shi bisa tsarin hukuma, a cikin burauzarku. Sannan ku ba ƙungiyarku taƙaitaccen bayani na shugabanni: shafi ɗaya, shirye don bugawa, akwai shi cikin Faransanci, Jamusanci, da Sifaniyanci.

meta.title: Waɗanda Pain001 Ya Dace Da Su
meta.description: Baitulmali, CFO da kwamitin gudanarwa, ayyukan biyan kuɗi, injiniyanci da AI: matsalar cikin kalmominku, abin da Pain001 ke canzawa, da matakinku na gaba, cikin kalmomi 150 ga kowane matsayi.
meta.deck: Matsayi huɗu, kalmomi huɗu, bututun aiki ɗaya. Ku nemo matsalarku, sannan matakinku na gaba.

text.Treasury &amp; finance<a class=\"heading: Baitulmali da kuɗi#
text.Your bank rejects files for reasons your: Bankinku yana ƙin fayiloli saboda dalilai da ERP ɗinku bai taɓa gargaɗin ku a kansu ba: lambar IBAN da aka juyar, jimillar sarrafawa da ba ta ƙara dacewa ba, tsarin adireshi da ya daina karɓuwa. Pain001 yana sa waɗannan gazawar su faru a teburinku maimakon haka. Ana tabbatar da kowane fayil bisa ƙa'idar hukuma ta banki (ISO 20022 XSD) kafin mikawa, kuma jagorar tsarin rayuwar biyan kuɗi tana nuna inda kowane bincike yake tsakanin farawa da daidaitawa. Ku fara da ƙamus idan kalmomin sababbi ne; an rubuta ma'anonin cikin sauƙaƙƙen harshe don ɓangarenku na tebur, ba na injiniyoyi ba.
text.CFO &amp; board<a class=\"heading-anchor: CFO da kwamitin gudanarwa#
text.Two numbers frame the decision. <strong>: Lambobi biyu ne ke tsara shawarar. Kafin ƙarshen Disamba 2026: lokacin da Swift za ta wallafa sabuwar ranar ƙin biyan kuɗi na tsakanin ƙasashe masu adireshi marasa tsari, buƙatar da ta ɗage a watan Agusta 2026 amma ba ta soke ba (Swift). Haɗarin yana cikin bayanan asali na abokan cinikinku, ba cikin haɗin bankinku ba. €10,000–30,000 a kowace shekara: farashin da aka wallafa na mafi kusancin SDK na fassara na kasuwanci, idan aka kwatanta da sifilin dindindin na Pain001 a kowane girma ƙarƙashin lasisoshin buɗe. Tambayoyin shugabanci (ikon dubawa, wurin ajiye bayanai, shaidar sarƙar samarwa) ana amsa su da kayan shaida, ba da tabbacin baki ba: SBOM da aka wallafa, manufar tsaro, da sarrafawa da ba ta taɓa barin na'urorinku. An rubuta taƙaitaccen bayani na shugabanni na shafi ɗaya don a tura shi gaba.
text.Payment operations<a class=\"heading-anc: Ayyukan biyan kuɗi#
text.You live in the response files. Pain001: Kuna rayuwa cikin fayilolin amsa. Pain001 yana rufe da'irar daga farko har ƙarshe: binciken kafin mikawa na --dry-run da ke ci ko faɗuwa a fili cikin CI, littattafan ƙa'idodin tsare-tsare (SEPA da na tsakanin ƙasashe) da aka bayyana ƙa'ida bayan ƙa'ida, jagorar lambobin dalili na pain.002 don fassara abin da ya dawo, da na'urorin fassara da ke mai da amsoshin banki da bayanan camt.053 zuwa tsararrun bayanai da bututunku zai iya turawa. Gwajin burauza ita ce hanya mafi sauri don ganin nau'ikan gazawar da yake kawarwa, gami da yanayin “saka kuskure” na danna sau ɗaya.
text.Engineering &amp; AI<a class=\"heading-a: Injiniyanci da AI#
text.A typed Python API, a CLI with meaningfu: API na Python mai nau'i, CLI mai lambobin fita masu ma'ana, ƙaramin sabis na REST, da wuraren ƙari don masu ɗaukar bayanai, masu tantancewa, tsare-tsare, da marubuta. Bayanin fasaha ya rufe kowace tuta da kowace hanyar shiga, kuma lambar tana ɗauke da kashi 100% na rufe layi-da-rassa a matsayin tsayayyar ƙofar CI. Idan kuna ginawa da wakilan AI: pain001-mcp shi ne kaɗai sabar Model Context Protocol a wannan fanni, da kayan aiki goma sha bakwai na karatu kawai da wakilanku ke kira a cikin gida, tare da bincike na edita daga pain001-lsp yayin da mutane ke ci gaba da sa ido.

meta.title: Taƙaitaccen Bayanin Pain001 ga Shugabanni
meta.description: Shafi ɗaya ga masu yanke shawara: matsalar fayil da aka ƙi, buƙatar adireshi mai tsari da sabon lokacinta, abin da Pain001 ke yi, kuɗinsa, shaidar aminci, da roƙo guda. Shirye don bugawa.
meta.deck: Shafi ɗaya. Gaskiya biyar. Roƙo guda. Akwai kuma cikin Faransanci, Jamusanci, da Sifaniyanci, shirye don bugawa daga burauzarku.

text.<strong>To print or save as PDF:</strong: Don bugawa ko ajiyewa a matsayin PDF: yi amfani da aikin bugawa na burauzarku (⌘P / Ctrl+P). Wannan shafin yana ɗauke da salon bugu da ke samar da shafi guda mai tsafta: babu kewayawa, babu ƙasan shafi, an rubuta hanyoyin haɗi cikakke.
text.The problem<a class=\"heading-anchor\" h: Matsalar#
text.Banks reject malformed payment files. Ev: Bankuna suna ƙin fayilolin biyan kuɗi da ba su da tsari. Kowace ƙi tana kashe zagayen gyara guda; gyaran da ya rasa lokacin rufewa na ranar yana kashe ranar sasantawa guda. Ana iya sanin dalilan ƙin tun da wuri, saboda haka ana iya rigakafinsu.
text.The deadline<a class=\"heading-anchor\": Wa'adin#
text.<strong>Deferred, not dropped.</strong>: An ɗage, ba a soke ba. A watan Agusta 2026 Swift ta ɗage dokar da ke ƙin biyan kuɗi na tsakanin ƙasashe (CBPR+) masu adireshi marasa tsari gaba ɗaya, da sauyawa daga MT101 na tsakanin bankuna zuwa ISO 20022 pain.001 sigar 9. Sabon lokaci zai zo kafin ƙarshen Disamba 2026. Haɗarin yana cikin bayanan asali na abokan ciniki har yanzu, kuma ranakun da aka riga aka sanya suna nan: Yuni 2027 (bincike), Nuwamba 2027 (lambobin manufar CHAPS), Nuwamba 2028 (bayanan asusu na MT). Majiya: Swift da bankunan tsakiya, an ambata cikakke a pain001.com/2026-iso20022-migration-trends.
text.What Pain001 does<a class=\"heading-anch: Abin da Pain001 ke yi#
text.An open-source suite that converts exist: Tarin buɗaɗɗen tushe da ke mai da bayanan da ake da su (maƙunsar bayanai, fitarwar ERP, tsofaffin fayilolin SWIFT) zuwa fayilolin biyan kuɗi na ISO 20022 da bankuna ke karɓa, kuma yana tabbatar da kowane fayil bisa ƙa'idar hukuma ta banki (ISO 20022 XSD) kafin mikawa. Yana gudana gaba ɗaya a kan na'urorinku: babu ɗorawa, babu gajimaren mai sayarwa, babu telemetry.
text.What it costs<a class=\"heading-anchor\": Kuɗinsa#
text.Nothing, at any scale, under open licenc: Babu komai, a kowane girma, ƙarƙashin lasisoshin buɗe (Apache-2.0 / MIT). Misalin kasuwanci: an lissafa SDK na fassara na SWIFT a fili kan €10,000–30,000 a kowace shekara.
text.Support, an LTS line and private profile: Ana bayar da tallafi, layin LTS da aikin bayanan sirri bisa jagorar bankinku dabam, ba tare da canza lasisin ba: shafin kamfanoni.
text.The evidence<a class=\"heading-anchor\": Shaidar#
text.Published dependency inventory (SBOM) ·: Jerin abubuwan dogaro da aka wallafa (SBOM) · lamba mai kashi 100% na rufe rassa a matsayin ƙofar CI · sarƙar samarwa da ƙungiya mai zaman kanta ta tantance (OpenSSF Scorecard) · takardu masu sauƙin isa na WCAG 2.2 AAA · manufar tsaro mai bayyanawa a sirrance. Duk ana iya tabbatar da su a pain001.com.
text.The ask<a class=\"heading-anchor\" href=: Roƙon#
text.Have your payments engineering team run: Ku sa ƙungiyar injiniyoyin biyan kuɗinku su gudanar da gwajin daƙiƙa 60 a pain001.com/try. Yana tantance rukunin samfuri kuma yana tabbatar da shi bisa tsarin hukuma na ISO 20022, a cikin burauza, ba tare da ɗora komai ba. Idan ya tsaya daram, jagorar shigarwa tana ɗaukar 'yan mintuna.

meta.title: Mene ne pain.001? Saƙon ISO 20022 na fara canja wurin kuɗi
meta.description: pain.001 shi ne saƙon XML na ISO 20022 da kamfani ke aika wa bankinsa don ba da umarnin canja wurin kuɗi. Tsarinsa, sigogi daga .03 zuwa .13, misali da aka tabbatar, da bambancinsa da pain.002, pain.008, pacs.008 da MT101.
meta.deck: Saƙon ISO 20022 da kamfani ke aika wa bankinsa don ba da umarnin canja wurin kuɗi: menene shi, yadda aka gina shi, wace siga za a yi amfani da ita, da cikakken misali da ya wuce ingancin tsarin hukuma.

text.The ISO 20022 message a company sends it: Saƙon ISO 20022 da kamfani ke aika wa bankinsa don ba da umarnin canja wurin kuɗi: menene shi, yadda aka gina shi, wace siga za a yi amfani da ita, da cikakken misali da ya wuce tantancewa da tsarin hukuma.
text.<a href=\"#why-banks-reject-pain-001-fil: Dalilin da yasa bankuna ke ƙin fayilolin pain.001
text.<strong>pain.001</strong> is the ISO 200: pain.001 shi ne saƙon ISO 20022 da kamfani ke aika wa bankinsa don ba da umarnin canja wurin kuɗi ɗaya ko fiye. Cikakken sunansa shi ne Customer Credit Transfer Initiation: "pain" shi ne rukunin saƙonnin fara biyan kuɗi, .001 lambar saƙon ce, kuma ƙarin da ke biye, kamar pain.001.001.09, ita ce sigar. Yana cikin tsarin XML, ana tantance shi da tsarin hukuma (XSD), kuma yana maye gurbin tsarin CSV na kowane banki da saƙon rubutu na SWIFT MT101.
text.pain.001 in one minute<a class=\"heading: pain.001 a cikin minti ɗaya#
text.<strong>Who sends it:</strong> a company: Wa ke aika shi: kamfani (mai biya, ko wakilin da ke aiki a madadinsa) yana aika shi zuwa bankinsa (bankin mai biya).
text.<strong>What it carries:</strong> one or: Abin da ke ciki: rukuni ɗaya ko fiye na canja wurin kuɗi, kowanne da asusun cirewa, ranar aiwatarwa da aka nema, da duk adadin biyan kuɗi ga masu karɓa.
text.<strong>What comes back:</strong> the ba: Abin da ke dawowa: banki yana amsa da pain.002, wato Customer Payment Status Report, wanda ke karɓa ko ƙin fayil ɗin ko wasu mu'amaloli tare da lambobin dalili na ISO.
text.<strong>What happens next:</strong> once: Abin da ke biye: bayan an karɓa, banki yana mai da kowane umarni zuwa saƙonnin tsakanin bankuna kamar pacs.008, waɗanda kamfanin ba ya taɓa gani.
text.<strong>Where it is used:</strong> SEPA: Inda ake amfani da shi: canja wurin kuɗi na SEPA ƙarƙashin dokokin EPC, biyan kuɗi na ƙetare iyaka a Swift ƙarƙashin CBPR+ (pain.001.001.09), da tsarin cikin gida da yawa. Tarin misalai na Pain001 ya ƙunshi yanayi 42 a kasuwanni 17.
text.How a pain.001 message is structured<a c: Yadda aka tsara saƙon pain.001#
text.Every version shares the same three-leve: Kowace siga tana da tsari iri ɗaya mai matakai uku a cikin ɓangaren <CstmrCdtTrfInitn>.
text.Message ID, creation timestamp, number o: Lambar saƙo, lokacin ƙirƙira, adadin mu'amaloli (NbOfTxs), jimlar tantancewa (CtrlSum), ɓangaren da ya fara
text.One batch: payment method, requested exe: Rukuni ɗaya: hanyar biyan kuɗi, ranar aiwatarwa da aka nema, mai biya, asusu da bankin mai biya, wanda ke ɗaukar kuɗin caji
text.One payment: end-to-end reference, amoun: Biyan kuɗi ɗaya: lambar tunani daga farko zuwa ƙarshe, adadi da kuɗi, mai karɓa, asusu da bankin mai karɓa, bayanin biyan kuɗi
text.A file can hold several <code>&lt;PmtInf: Fayil zai iya ƙunsar rukunoni da yawa na <PmtInf>, kuma kowane rukuni biyan kuɗi da yawa na <CdtTrfTxInf>. NbOfTxs da CtrlSum suna bayyana a matakin fayil da na rukuni, kuma dole ne su dace da biyan kuɗin da suke ƙidaya; wannan yana ɗaya daga cikin dalilan da suka fi yawa da yasa banki ke ƙin fayil.
text.A complete pain.001 example<a class=\"he: Cikakken misalin pain.001#
text.This is a single SEPA credit transfer in: Wannan canja wurin kuɗi ɗaya ne na SEPA a cikin pain.001.001.09, wanda aka ɗauko ba tare da canji ba daga tarin misalai na Pain001. Yana wuce tantancewa da XSD na hukuma na ISO 20022. Ɓangarorin, IBAN da BIC na ƙage ne.
text.Try your own data in the <a href=\"/try/: Gwada bayananku a cikin nunin a burauza: yana gina fayil ɗin pain.001 daga CSV kuma yana tantance shi da tsarin hukuma ba tare da bayananku sun bar na'urarku ba.
text.pain.001 versions<a class=\"heading-anch: Sigogin pain.001#
text.ISO publishes a new version when the mes: ISO tana fitar da sabuwar siga idan tsarin saƙon ya canza. Bankuna da tsare-tsare suna karɓar wasu sigogi, don haka sigar da za ku aika ita ce wadda takardun tashar bankinku suka ambata.
text.The long-standing SEPA and CGI workhorse: Tsohuwar siga mai aiki ta SEPA da CGI; tana gane bankuna da <BIC>
text.Maintenance versions used by particular: Sigogin kulawa da wasu tashoshi ke amfani da su
text.The 2019 version CBPR+ selected for Swif: Sigar 2019 da CBPR+ ta zaɓa don Swift; tana gane bankuna da <BICFI>, kuma tana ƙara ɗaukar LEI da UETR
text.Published by ISO on 19 March 2026; adds: ISO ta fitar da ita ranar 19 ga Maris 2026; tana ƙara lambar musamman ta mu'amala ta zaɓi (UnqTxIdr)
text.The <a href=\"/compatibility/\">compatib: Teburin dacewa yana nuna sigogin da Pain001 ke samarwa, tantancewa da sauyawa a tsakaninsu.
text.pain.001 compared with related messages<: Kwatanta pain.001 da saƙonni masu alaƙa#
text.Orders credit transfers (pushes money ou: Yana ba da umarnin canja wurin kuɗi (yana tura kuɗi waje)
text.Reports the status of a pain.001 or pain: Yana ba da rahoton matsayin pain.001 ko pain.008: an karɓa, an karɓa wani ɓangare ko an ƙi, tare da lambobin dalili
text.Orders direct debits (collects money und: Yana ba da umarnin cire kuɗi kai tsaye (yana karɓar kuɗi bisa izini)
text.The interbank credit transfer a pain.001: Canja wurin kuɗi na tsakanin bankuna da umarnin pain.001 ke zama
text.Company or bank, over Swift: Kamfani ko banki, ta hanyar Swift
text.The legacy text &quot;Request for Transf: Tsohon saƙon rubutu "Request for Transfer" da pain.001 ke maye gurbinsa. Swift ta jinkirta dakatar da isar da MT101 tsakanin bankuna a watan Agusta 2026 (Swift); duba Daga MT101 zuwa pain.001
text.The <a href=\"/glossary/\">glossary</a>: Ƙamus yana bayyana sauran kalmomin ISO 20022 cikin sauƙi.
text.Why banks reject pain.001 files<a class=: Dalilin da yasa bankuna ke ƙin fayilolin pain.001#
text.A file can be well-formed XML and still: Fayil na iya zama XML mai tsari daidai amma har yanzu a ƙi shi. Binciken yana taruwa a matakai:
text.<strong>Schema:</strong> the file must v: Tsari: dole ne fayil ɗin ya wuce tantancewa da XSD na hukuma na sigarsa.
text.<strong>Data quality:</strong> IBANs pas: Ingancin bayanai: lambobin tantancewa na IBAN sun dace, BIC suna da tsari daidai, kwanaki da adadi suna da inganci, kuma NbOfTxs da CtrlSum sun dace da biyan kuɗin.
text.<strong>Scheme rules:</strong> SEPA, CBP: Dokokin tsari: SEPA, CBPR+ da tsare-tsaren cikin gida suna ƙara nasu sharuɗɗa, kamar haruffan da aka yarda da su ko adireshin wasiƙa mai tsari.
text.<strong>Your bank's profile and channel:: Bayanin bankinku da tashar sa: kowane banki yana fitar da nasa jagororin amfani a kan tsarin.
text.Pain001 checks the first three layers be: Pain001 yana bincika matakai uku na farko kafin fayil ɗin ya isa banki, kuma yana bayyana a fili cewa banki ne zai tabbatar da na huɗu.
text.How to create a pain.001 file<a class=\": Yadda ake ƙirƙirar fayil ɗin pain.001#
text.<strong>From a spreadsheet:</strong> <a: Daga takardar lissafi: Daga Excel zuwa pain.001 yana mai da jerin biyan kuɗi na Excel ko CSV zuwa fayil da aka tantance.
